name: App source snapshot restore integrity
trigger: Snapshot a deployment source tree, restore a matching snapshot, then exercise mismatched, missing, corrupt and concurrent-writer cases.
observe: restore matches the recorded source fingerprint
mismatch or corrupt state refuses before changing the target
concurrent writers retain isolated object keys and ledger results
expected: A deployment source can be restored only from the matching immutable snapshot; invalid or racing writes cannot silently replace another deployment revision.
